<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.31.0-beta -->

## What's Changed
### New Features
* feat: Show multi-output pipeline status in diagnostics by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/45
* feat: Add NVR substream support for multi-view layouts by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/48
### Bug Fixes
* fix: Add input validation limits and improve Cast All dialogs by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/44
* fix: Increase diagnostics polling rate and add Apply button for scaled settings by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/47
### Performance
* perf: Use VAAPI hardware decode for multi-output pipelines by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/46


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/compare/v0.30.5-beta...v0.31.0-beta
